_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With fed_liquidity at extreme tightness and stablecoin_growth below confirmation threshold, the coil lacks capital deployment fuel to break in either direction, and the 56% base rate for ±2+ point moves doesn't specify direction — forcing a directional guess in a coil is how the record went 0-for-18.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial split — both call HOLD/Complacency for current state, but narrative implies coiled spring ready to strike while analyst insists neither side has fuel yet
next_move.confirmed_if: stablecoin_growth breaks above 60 AND btc_momentum_30d reclaims 65 with funding rising above 60
next_move.invalidated_if: vix climbs above 75 AND gold_strength holds 95+ while btc_momentum_30d drops below 40
